note: Pre-recorded run of server/simulator.py for the static demo; synthetic data.

chapters.label: Baseline day
chapters.description: All three astronauts and the cabin are inside their personal ranges.

chapters.label: Cognitive stress · Astronaut 002
chapters.description: Slower reaction time, more lapses and higher anxiety on 002's check-ins open a cognitive-stress alert.

chapters.label: Cabin CO₂ buildup
chapters.description: CO₂ climbs, worst in the Work module. The shared cabin alert lights every crew member's lungs.

chapters.label: Warm, humid cabin
chapters.description: Temperature and humidity rise together (Systems module first) and the thermal alert opens.

chapters.label: Recovery
chapters.description: Scenarios end; readings return inside the recovery band and alerts close.

scenarios.label: Elevated resting heart rate
scenarios.description: Raises the selected astronaut’s heart rate during awake rest.

scenarios.label: Cognitive stress
scenarios.description: Slows reaction time and raises lapses and state anxiety on a simulated check-in.

scenarios.label: Cabin CO₂ buildup
scenarios.description: Raises cabin CO₂ as in a ventilation or removal problem.

scenarios.label: Warm, humid cabin
scenarios.description: Raises cabin temperature and relative humidity together.

heart_rate_bpm.note: Seated cuff HR (awake) and BIDSleep stage HR (asleep); dynamics synthetic.

blood_pressure.note: Seated cuff systolic/diastolic; activity and sleep offsets are synthetic.

co2_ppm.note: NASA EDA RR-6 ISS cabin daily profile.

temperature_c.note: NASA EDA RR-6 ISS cabin daily profile.

relative_humidity_pct.note: NASA EDA RR-6 ISS cabin daily profile.

radiation.note: NASA RadLab DosTel1 5-min medians; cumulative absorbed dose is the rate integrated over simulated time since run start. Dose equivalent absent and not estimated.

noise_dba.note: No noise data supplied; demo assumption only.

sensors.note: Zone sensors are deterministic offsets of the measured cabin profile; scenario effects are concentrated in one zone. Alerts are evaluated on the cabin-wide reading only.

o2_and_pressure.note: Fixed 21% O2 / 101.3 kPa reference; not measured.
